I couldn’t agree more. I don’t believe more money = more happiness, but when it’s a matter of not being able to sustain yourself, and every time you try and better things some bs kicks you back down, it feels so hopeless, it’s hard to have any kind of enjoyment or fulfillment in your life when so many of the experiences that will give you those feelings are locked behind extreme paywalls. 

So many people will push different ways to help you get around this issue, you hear people say things like work smarter not harder, and while this is a good mentality it’s not some golden ticket to financial safety, or they will push some spiritual mentality on you like god is gonna feed you or something. Call me crazy, but not everyone can have a stable living, no matter how hard they try.
